title: PARROT: PERSUASION AND AGREEMENT ROBUSTNESS RATING OF OUTPUT TRUTH — A SYCOPHANCY ROBUSTNESS BENCHMARK FOR LLMS
reasoning: The paper focuses on sycophancy (excessive conformity) in LLMs by testing if models change their answers to factual or logical questions when faced with expert pressure. While it mentions 'moral sycophancy' in related work and includes 'philosophy' as an MMLU testing domain, its primary objective is evaluating epistemic robustness and factual integrity rather than specifically benchmarking religion, ethics, or moral frameworks.
